target_type: node+python (Express server + Python launcher, mobile monitor for Antigravity AI IDE)

features.name: isLocalRequest() LAN bypass + proxy-header detect
features.description: Checks x-forwarded-for/x-forwarded-host FIRST (blocks tunnel bypass), then RFC-1918 range check. LAN devices auto-trusted, external zero-trust. Critical: proxy-headers checked before IP to prevent tunnel bypass.
features.counter_case: In containerized/Kubernetes deployments 192.168.x.x is pod-network space; LAN trust should be opt-out via CORTEX_LAN_BYPASS=false env var.

features.name: Hash-diff skip WebSocket broadcast
features.description: hashString(snapshot.html) compared to lastSnapshotHash; broadcast only fires when content actually changed. Prevents unnecessary re-renders on idle clients.
features.counter_case: djb2 hash used here is not collision-resistant. Phase 8.1 should use SHA-256 or compare a content-addressed entity fingerprint rather than the full payload hash.

features.name: Startup warning for insecure defaults
features.description: console.warn with ANSI color when APP_PASSWORD, SESSION_SECRET, or AUTH_SALT match known defaults. Three separate checks across startup.
features.counter_case: Warnings are easy to ignore. In production mode, prefer refusing to start without a proper secret rather than warning and continuing.

features.name: Magic link QR code auto-login with key-strip redirect
features.description: ?key=PASSWORD in URL sets signed httpOnly cookie then redirects to / to strip key from URL. Prevents browser-history credential leakage.
features.counter_case: Credentials in query params appear in access logs and referrer headers before redirect fires. Use short-lived single-use JWT magic tokens rather than raw password.

features.name: Signed httpOnly cookie auth with cookieParser
features.description: cookieParser(sessionSecret) + {httpOnly: true, signed: true, maxAge: 30d}. Token never in JS context. req.signedCookies[name] === AUTH_TOKEN for verification.
features.counter_case: Phase 22 already specifies JWT for API auth which is more stateless and works for non-browser clients. Signed cookies are additive for browser dashboard only, not a JWT replacement.

features.name: QR code terminal print for connection URL
features.description: qrcode.QRCode + print_ascii(invert=True). Prints scannable QR in terminal at server startup. Mobile device scans instead of typing long URL.
features.counter_case: Block-character QR codes require adequate terminal contrast and monospace rendering. In CI/SSH sessions the QR is garbled. Make it opt-in via --qr flag.

features.name: LAN-first IP priority sort (192.168 > 10.x > 172.x)
features.description: Ranks network interfaces by RFC-1918 range priority to avoid reporting WSL2/Docker virtual adapter as the primary IP. Sorted by priority score.
features.counter_case: In containerized deployments all IPs are virtual; the 172.x deprioritization is wrong in Kubernetes/Docker. Need env-detection step (DOCKER_HOST / KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST) to skip heuristic.

features.name: CSP zero-inline-JS via complete event handler refactor
features.description: script-src 'self' with no 'unsafe-inline'. Achieved by moving 100% of event handlers from HTML to app.js. Prevents XSS via injected inline scripts.
features.counter_case: Mermaid/Cytoscape may inject script tags dynamically. Verify each graph library works under strict CSP before committing to 'self'-only. May need nonce-based approach.

features.name: Port kill on startup (cross-platform EADDRINUSE prevention)
features.description: netstat -ano + taskkill (Windows) / lsof -ti + kill -9 (Linux/macOS). Finds and kills any process holding the server port before binding.
features.counter_case: Silently killing processes on a port is aggressive; a developer's other service would be killed without warning. Prefer: fail with clear error + kill command hint rather than auto-kill.

features.name: Hybrid SSL generation (OpenSSL → Node.js crypto fallback)
features.description: Tries openssl in PATH, then C:\Program Files\Git\usr\bin\openssl.exe (Git-for-Windows), falls to pure node:crypto ASN.1 builder. OpenSSL path produces certs with IP SAN extensions.
features.counter_case: Self-signed certs require browser click-through. For Phase 22 production, ACME/Let's Encrypt is far better. Hybrid approach right for zero-config local dev only.

features.name: ngrok skip-browser-warning header
features.description: res.setHeader('ngrok-skip-browser-warning', 'true') on all responses. Required for API calls through ngrok to not get intercepted by the ngrok browser warning page.
features.counter_case: Only relevant when ngrok is the tunnel provider. Cloudflare Tunnel and Tailscale don't have this issue.

features.name: Multi-tunnel support (ngrok/Cloudflare/Pinggy/SSH)
features.description: TUNNEL_PROVIDER env var routes to ngrok, cloudflare, or pinggy. Already in Cortex Phase 33.2 (Remote Operations & Mobile Status PWA).

features.name: CDP-based DOM mirroring + snapshot
features.description: CDP Runtime.evaluate to clone DOM, strip UI chrome, base64-inline images, extract CSS. Sends snapshot to phone browser.
features.principle_violated: MCP-first: Cortex does not control a browser process; CDP integration requires a running Chromium-based IDE

features.name: Fuzzy element selection / leaf-node isolation / occurrence index
features.description: 3-tier fallback element selection; leaf-most filtering; elements[index] for nth occurrence. CDP browser automation patterns.
features.principle_violated: MCP-first: browser automation has no Cortex equivalent

features.name: Hardcoded fallback credentials with console.warn
features.description: APP_PASSWORD='antigravity', AUTH_SALT='antigravity_default_salt_99', SESSION_SECRET='antigravity_secret_key_1337'. Predictable defaults remain active if user ignores warnings.
features.principle_violated: Security: discoverable from public GitHub repo; warnings alone are insufficient mitigation
features.counter_case: Zero-config is a stated goal; hard-blocking on missing secrets breaks demo/first-run experience. Soft warning is a reasonable trade-off for local-only tools.
